message.trainmod.buffer_site: Use the buffer stop on a clear section of rail.
message.trainmod.buffer_reached: The tunnel bore stops at the buffer.
message.trainmod.place_vehicle: Place this vehicle on complete track.
message.trainmod.coupler_selected: Coupler selected. Use the tool on the next vehicle's facing coupler.
message.trainmod.coupler_alignment: Place stopped vehicles about three to five blocks apart on the same route and aim at the facing ends.
message.trainmod.route_unavailable: Stopped. The vehicle is not on complete track.
message.trainmod.bore_on: Tunnel bore working. Drive forward to cut.
message.trainmod.bore_drive_working: Bore work is on. Drive forward to lay track. Press jump to pause.
message.trainmod.bore_drive_paused: Bore work is off. Press jump to enable track laying.
message.trainmod.bore_enable_work: End of track. Press jump to enable track laying.
message.trainmod.bore_full: Bore stopped at %s. There is no cargo space for %s.
tooltip.trainmod.track_builder: Use in air to select. Use once on a support to build.
tooltip.trainmod.coupler: Use on facing vehicle ends. Right-click a linked coupler to release it.
tooltip.trainmod.locomotive: Use to board. Sneak-use to load diesel buckets.
tooltip.trainmod.flatcar: 27 cargo slots. Use the rear wheel to set the handbrake.
tooltip.trainmod.gondola: 27 cargo slots. Sneak-use to board. Use the rear wheel to brake.
tooltip.trainmod.boxcar: 27 cargo slots. Sneak-use to board. Use the rear wheel to brake.
tooltip.trainmod.tunnel_bore: Sneak-use for supplies. Use with a chest for cargo. Press jump while driving to toggle work.
tooltip.trainmod.ballast_car: Use for gravel or ballast. Sneak-use to toggle regulation.
tooltip.trainmod.treecutters_passenger_c: Use the lantern to send a villager to cut nearby trees. Couple a gondola to collect logs.
tooltip.trainmod.track: Use on a support block or an open rail end to place the whole piece.
tooltip.trainmod.handed_track: Use on a support or rail end. Aim left or right to choose the branch.
message.trainmod.track_site: Track needs a clear, supported route and matching rail ends.
message.trainmod.drive_controls: Hold forward or backward to drive. Release to brake.
tooltip.trainmod.rising_curve: Start uphill from a straight or diagonal rail. Aim to choose the curve direction.
tooltip.trainmod.grade: Click the low end while facing uphill. Can start on level ground.
message.trainmod.brake_holding: Stopped. Release the handbrakes on the coupled cars.
message.trainmod.bore_need_rail: Bore stopped. Load %s extruded rails into its supply slot or a trailing gondola.
message.trainmod.bore_support: Place the rear rail wheels on a straight track.
message.trainmod.bore_need_ties: Bore stopped. Load tie bundles into its supply slot or a trailing gondola.
message.trainmod.bore_need_stone: Bore stopped. Load cobblestone into its supply slot or a trailing gondola.
message.trainmod.bore_too_many_logs: Bore stopped at %s. Too many logs are connected to the cut.
message.trainmod.bore_heading: Bore stopped. The track must end on a level straight or diagonal to continue the cut.
message.trainmod.bore_entity: Bore stopped at %s. %s is in the cut.
message.trainmod.bore_unloaded: Bore stopped. The chunk containing %s is not loaded.
message.trainmod.bore_world_limit: Bore stopped. %s is outside the build limits.
message.trainmod.bore_misaligned: Bore stopped. The rail at %s does not connect.
message.trainmod.bore_protected: Bore stopped. Breaking the block at %s is not allowed.
message.trainmod.bore_track_in_cut: Bore stopped. Existing rail at %s crosses the cut.
message.trainmod.bore_block_entity: Bore stopped. %2$s at %1$s must be removed by hand.
message.trainmod.bore_place_denied: Bore stopped. The cut and rail placement were rejected at %s.
tooltip.trainmod.straight_track: Face along the run. Look at 45° to lay a diagonal, or use an open rail end.
message.trainmod.consist_unavailable: Stopped. A linked car is unavailable.
message.trainmod.end_of_track: Stopped at the end of the connected rail.
message.trainmod.broken_track: Stopped at broken track. Right-click the damaged section to recycle it.
message.trainmod.tender_board: Use the green seat area on top of the tender.
message.trainmod.tender_not_coupled: Couple the tender directly to the steam locomotive to drive from this seat.
tooltip.trainmod.steam_locomotive: Couple to a steam tender for supplies and driving.
tooltip.trainmod.tender: Use the tender body for coal and water. Use the top seat to board.
tooltip.trainmod.electric_shunter: Use to board. Connected overhead wire powers travel and charges the reserve.
